sed_version.description: The version of GNU sed to target for the script generation.

sed_commands.description: A list of sed commands to execute. Each item is a string representing one or more sed commands (e.g., 's/old/new/g', '/pattern/d'). These map to the -e option or script file content.

input_file.description: The input file path for sed. Defaults to stdin if empty.

output_file.description: The output file path for sed. If empty, output goes to stdout.

quiet.description: If true, adds the -n flag to suppress automatic printing of the pattern space.

extended_regex.description: If true, adds the -E flag to use extended regular expressions.

in_place.description: If true, adds the -i flag to edit files in place.

line_length.description: The desired line-wrap length for the 'l' command. Maps to -l N.
